hooks.name: ui-wording-check
hooks.description: Keep UI copy to record-state wording (.kiro/steering/ui-copy.md)

action.prompt: UI copy may have changed. Check it against .kiro/steering/ui-copy.md. Flag evaluative words in Korean or English (such as 약속 파기, 거짓말, 실패, 꼼수, broken promise, lie, failure, trick) and propose record-state wording instead. Check that every verdict on screen shows its official link, clause location and original excerpt, and that translations are labeled. Change copy only, not logic.
